# LeakSanitizer suppressions for the CI sanitizers job.
#
# BLAS libraries allocate per-thread scratch buffers and never free them:
# that is by design, not a leak anyone can act on. Suppressing them by
# module is what lets leak detection stay ON for our own code, which is
# where it earns its keep -- it catches an option string that an early
# return forgot to free, for instance.
leak:libopenblas
leak:libgomp
